summary: A +2 dagger with a stacking critical threshold reduction and different main- and off-hand benefits.

fields.Improved Critical: Reduce the roll needed for a critical hit by 1. Stacks with similar effects.
fields.Main hand: Melee hits with Bloodthirst apply Piercing vulnerability for 1 turn. Throwing it does not trigger this effect.
fields.Off hand: +1 AC. When a melee attack misses you, spend your Reaction to attack with your main-hand weapon and gain True Strike for 2 turns.
fields.True Strike: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Requires concentration for up to 2 turns, including the turn you cast it. Gain advantage on your next attack roll against the selected target. The effect ends after that roll, hit or miss.
fields.Base value: 640 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Bound weapon: Returns when thrown and cannot be disarmed.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Recorded the native damage and the cast spell’s concentration and timing.
